title: MSL enhanced terrain adaptation
description: Gaussian-kernel terrain adaptation applied around structure pieces. Appears on the nether jigsaw structure and as a per-element override on versioned and mirroring pool elements.

kernel_size.description: Edge length of the 3-D falloff kernel in blocks. 0 disables adaptation.

kernel_distance.description: Distance divisor controlling how quickly the kernel falls off.

top.description: Terrain action applied above the piece base: carve removes terrain, bury adds it.

bottom.description: Terrain action applied below the piece base.

bottom_offset.description: Y offset applied to the piece base before deciding top vs bottom. Defaults to 0.

padding.description: Expands or shrinks the piece bounding box per axis before adapting terrain. All fields default to 0.

band.description: Restricts adaptation to a vertical band of each piece in piece-local rows (0 = piece floor). When present, top/bottom padding is ignored.

bottom.description: Lowest piece-local row the adaptation applies to.

top.description: Highest piece-local row the adaptation applies to.

piece_heights.description: If set, the band only applies to rigid pieces whose Y span matches one of these heights.
